addProject.title: Add your first project
addProject.description: Choose a folder. Sidequest keeps its Quests in a local .sidequest directory inside that exact folder.

quickCapture.title: Set up Quick Capture
quickCapture.description: Capture a Quest from any app without interrupting your flow. You can change these settings later.

agents.title: Connect coding agents
agents.description: Install the Sidequest skill for the coding agents you use. The managed sq CLI is installed automatically.
